title: ENHANCING LLM SAFETY VIA CONSTRAINED DIRECT PREFERENCE OPTIMIZATION
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not measure any aspect of faith or religion. The evaluation focuses on general helpfulness and harmlessness across safety dimensions like crime, social bias (gender), and physical harm.
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion, as it was not a focus of the research.
